title: feat(spec): Studio metadata-form select choices are translatable (metadataForms options slot)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPE7uyDAJyqjwwMzomWv5ff)_

Fixes #36950

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` names the `metadataForms` group only, never its leaf keys; the group is platform-owned, so no app author writes the new key

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：非英文的搭建者在 Studio 里打开对象、字段、报表、仪表盘、钩子、动作、页面、智能体、技能的配置表单时，下拉框里的选项名（例如共享模型「私有 — 仅所有者」、字段类型、删除行为、默认时间段）改为显示当前语言；以前这些选项在所有语言下都是英文，周围的字段名却已经翻译。
- 为什么做：翻译包里没有放选项名的位置，服务端也不翻译它们。
- 出错会怎样：只多翻译一层显示文字，选项的值不变，保存下来的数据不变；某个选项没有译文时仍显示原来的英文。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 改动约 3,790 行（主要是 10 种语言的译文），超过 3,000 行，按规则需要授权审批人批准后由座位落地。

## What changes

**The reading the card asked for** (at `021524cd`, `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` walked with the extractor's path rule): of the 18 registered Studio forms, 9 carry a select row with `options` — `object`, `field`, `hook`, `report`, `dashboard`, `action`, `page`, `agent`, `skill` — 38 rows, 187 options (185 distinct `type.path.value` keys: `object`'s `fields.deleteBehavior` is listed twice, with the same names). Every one is seen by a builder: the console's `SchemaForm` renders `fieldSpec.options` ahead of the schema enum (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, the enum/select branch), and the server translated only `label`, `helpText` and `placeholder` of a form field.

- **Spec, translation slot** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`). A `metadataForms.<type>.fields.<path>` entry accepts `options`: a record from option `value` to its translated name, the shape `objects.<object>.fields.<field>.options` already has. `choices` and `values` are refused there, as on the object-field face, and the refusal names `options` as the key to write (the `aliases` row of the strict object is the rename hint of that unknown-key refusal, not an accepted spelling).
- **Spec, resolver** (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`). `translateFormField` overlays each `options[]` entry's `label` with the translation keyed by its `value`, along the locale chain; an option with no translation, or with a non-string value, is passed through unchanged. This is the walker `resolveMetadataFormLabels` uses, which `/api/v1/meta/types` localizes served forms with.
- **Lint, extractor** (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`). `walkFormField` emits `metadataForms.<type>.fields.<path>.options.<value>` for every option of a row, seeded with its English label, so `os i18n extract` and `pnpm check:i18n` offer exactly the keys the resolver reads.
- **Platform-objects, shipped locales.** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` added the 185 keys to all eleven `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` packs; the ten translated packs then got hand-written names (ar, de, es-ES, fr, ja-JP, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, zh-Hant) and a second `--write` dropped every source-hash row they had seeded. The 17 Default Period choices take the wording of the console's own period chip (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, `dashboard.filters.range.*` and `dashboard.filters.custom`), so the period an author picks reads as the period a viewer sees. Loanwords that read the same as English (`URL`, `HTML`, `JSON`, `Markdown`, and per locale words such as de `Text`, fr `Date`) are spelled so they are not byte-echoes of the source, which the catalog's zero-echo pins require (`object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`, `report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts`): for example zh-CN `网址（URL）`, de `Textfeld`, fr `Date (sans heure)`.
- `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` regenerated (`gen:docs`).

Small calls made here (no card): the rename hints for `choices` / `values` mirror the object-field face; a non-string option value is passed through untouched rather than stringified, since every option a registered form lists has a string value (the reading found none other).

## Why

A non-English builder saw a translated field label with English choices under it on every server-rendered Studio form. The bundle had no slot for the names, so no locale could fix it.

## Verification

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`, new top-level describe "select option names": a choice is renamed by its value and keeps its other keys; a value with no translation keeps its English label; a nested repeater row is reached by its dot path; the input form is not mutated.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/metadata-translations/form-option-labels.test.ts` (new): through the SERVED bundle and the real registry, the object form's sharing model reads `私有 — 仅所有者` in zh-CN; the reading floor (≥30 option rows over ≥8 forms) holds; for each of the ten translated locales every choice of every form select has a non-empty name that differs from its English label.
- Local runs on this branch: `packages/spec` full suite green (vitest, 618 s); `packages/lint` 236 files / 9,680 tests green; `packages/platform-objects` translations + metadata-translations 29 files green; `packages/cli` `test/i18n-extract.test.ts` green; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` could not measure here (exit 3: the example apps are not built in this worktree), so CI carries that one; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0 after `gen:docs`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exit 0 against `origin/main` and the open PRs sharing these files (#37422, #37366).

Contract review (L2) is owed before landing: the diff changes `packages/spec/src/**` and declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Changed lines exceed 3,000, so landing needs an authorized approval.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
